newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Germany's Kohl arrives in Brazil for flying visit.
newsitem.headline: Germany's Kohl arrives in Brazil for flying visit.

text.p: German Chancellor Helmut Kohl landed in Brazil on Tuesday as part of a three-country tour of Latin America, an airport official said.

Kohl, arriving from Argentina and flying to Mexico next, will spend barely 24 hours in Brazil. The chancellor, who is heading a delegation of German businessmen, was due to meet President Fernando Henrique Cardoso later on Tuesday and local business leaders on Wednesday.

Germany is the second-largest foreign investor in Brazil, sporting a portfolio that amounted to $7 billion in 1995, and is Brazil's third most-important trading partner, with some $7.0 billion in annual bilateral trade.
